listening.sourceText:

listening.title: What the target leaves out
listening.sourceText:
The new service target requires our advice team to respond within one working day. This has reduced the number of requests left unanswered for weeks. However, the target counts an initial acknowledgement as a response. A quick message saying that a request has been received may be useful, but it does not show whether the underlying problem has been addressed. Our next report will therefore distinguish acknowledgement from substantive guidance and track whether clients need to make repeated requests. We are supplementing the speed measure, not suggesting that prompt replies are unimportant.
Question. What is the speaker’s main point?
